_standard: ACTIVE: a usable desktop browser you can download today, with a release in roughly the last 18 months, AND people actually use or discuss it today: major vendor, or 1k+ GitHub stars, or a regular in browser communities. A Wikipedia article alone is NOT enough.
DEAD: only household names or recent high-profile shutdowns (rip tag).

OUT: Chinese browsers; OS-specific ports (Haiku/Amiga/OS2/PowerPC); engine experiments without a usable browser; antivirus/vendor rebrands of Chromium; tiny forks of forks; legacy browsers nobody uses anymore.
EXCEPTION: meme browsers the community actually knows (Pissandshittium).
